objects.text: Operations Analyst with 8+ years of experience in operational analysis, process improvement, KPI reporting, workflow optimization, data analysis, documentation, and cross-functional operations coordination. Proven ability to enhance operational efficiency and drive data-informed decision-making across multiple departments.
• Analyzed key operational processes to identify inefficiencies, leading to a 15% improvement in workflow efficiency across departments.
• Developed and maintained operational KPI dashboards to enable timely reporting and informed decision-making by cross-functional teams.
• Led workflow optimization initiatives, streamlining interdepartmental processes to reduce cycle time by 20%.
• Conducted root-cause analysis of operational bottlenecks, implementing corrective actions that improved department efficiency and cost savings.
• Coordinated process improvement projects across multiple teams, resulting in enhanced reporting accuracy and workflow efficiency.
• Documented operational procedures and facilitated stakeholder communication to ensure consistent execution of key workflows.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to identify operational challenges and implement data-driven solutions improving overall efficiency.
• Coordinated process documentation and data collection efforts, resulting in improved operational transparency and consistency.
• Maintained operational schedules and quality assurance processes to support smooth project execution and timely reporting.
• Supported data analysis initiatives identifying operational improvements that contributed to cost reduction and process streamlining.
